channel.title: North Bay Nugget - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Bay Nugget (nugget.ca)

item.title: Online booking system for North Bay ice rinks and fields still far off
item.description: System was supposed to start in June, but has been put on the back burner while city works on broader digital and customer service strategy.

item.title: Evenly split council votes not to suspend Airbnb bylaw fees
item.description: North Bay council decides not not suspend fees from its short-term rental bylaw while it is retooled to get more property owners to comply.

item.title: Jordy Carr appointed as Mayor of Callander
item.description: Carr, who had been deputy mayor, says two vacant seats will also be also filled by choosing appropriate candidates without byelections.

item.title: Chris Sluman's leukemia fight has rallied an army of family and friends
item.description: The North Bay man was diagnosed with leukemia just over three weeks ago but also found out the cost to treat it is enormous

item.title: North Bay man charged with assault with weapon after brandishing a knife
item.description: Incident occurred at a residence in the 500 block of Lakeshore Drive.

item.title: It will be a tough weekend for the North Bay Battalion to right themselves
item.description: It is out of the frying pan and into the fire for the Battalion. After two losses in the Soo, the Troops hit the road to face Windsor, London, and then Niagara.

item.title: King, Mitchell and Chirico all return to key positions on DNSSAB
item.description: There are no changes in the board structure of District of Nipissing Social Services Administration Board, including Mark King as chair, Lana Mitchell as vice-chair and Mayor Peter Chirico as Chair of the Finance Committee

item.title: Fiona Madigan gets to shoot for glory next fall in the NCAA ranks
item.description: Madigan has lived in Orangeville, playing at an elite basketball academy that has developed many kids into US college players
